message:
feat(bot): category icons in autocomplete and item lists, big sticker image

- Discord cannot show images in autocomplete suggestions (plain text only), so
  each suggestion now carries a per-category emoji plus the value:
  '🧸 Star Cub — 9.5-10★' instead of 'Star Cub (9.5-10 ★)'
- /price reply now embeds the sticker as a large image, not just a thumbnail
- /calc and /logtrade list items with the same category icon
- fixed parseTradeLine dropping qty and category, which made /logtrade render
  'undefinedx Star Cub'
author: BSS Index Developer
